answer.new_information: NN, Inc. (not a covered NVDA ticker) announced in late June 2026 a 47-machine-center liquid cooling expansion at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, stated as 100% pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and targeted US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026. The record also notes NN's removal from the Russell Microcap Value Index in late June 2026. The NN revenue and earnings projections to 2028 are third-party narrative and unnamed-analyst figures, and the 2028 analyst figures are rumour-tier. None of these are NVDA period or definition matches for a stored question, and no stored pieces or catalog questions exist to update.
answer.reason: No questions_to_consider, stored_pieces or catalog entries are supplied, so there is no existing argument to update. The record is a supplier-side pickup for NN, Inc., which is outside the NVDA research scope; it is relevant only as context for NVIDIA's Asian supply chain. The 100% pre-sold and US$80-90m figures are company statements with a stated 2026 target, not results, and the Russell removal, narrative projections and unnamed-analyst estimates move nothing on NVDA. No investment judgement that could change the NVDA position is carried, so no new question is proposed.
